notes: Recall cases over the frozen graph. Each names the leg it exercises, the constraints the router would have produced, and the events that must come back - by uid_hint, never by uid, because the writer mints uids at seed time. `expect` is exact for the template and nearby legs: those are filters, and a filter that returns a fourth event when three match is as wrong as one that misses one. The vector leg is scored as recall@k instead, since ranking by cosine similarity is not a set membership question. `forbidden` names events that must never appear in that case's answer.

test_cases.why: the free jam is jazz too; the past jazz night at the same venue is not upcoming
a city with no other constraint: everything upcoming and scheduled, and nothing else
genre narrows inside the right city
an identity ask crosses cities and needs no place
venue matching is CONTAINS on the normalised name, so Sala Apolo and Sala Apolo 2 both answer - and Razzmatazz, 3 km away, does not
the filter is price_min <= ceiling, so a 12-euro door passes and the free jam does too
country is a filter of its own, not a city spelled differently
date_to is exclusive, so the gig on day three is out; the window is written in days because the fixture's dates are seeded relative to now
the first rung of the radius ladder is 5 km, which covers every Madrid venue and no other city
an explicit radius pins the ladder to one rung: Razzmatazz is 3 km out and must not be pulled in
